reason: I have run my practice on Excel and WhatsApp for ten years without paying for software, and spending time training article clerks who rotate out every two to three years on a new platform is a waste of time. My spreadsheet routine already gets my Saturday GST reconciliations done for free, so I see no reason to pay ₹12,990 upfront.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time when spreadsheets and WhatsApp already work.
would_change_my_mind: If the software requires zero onboarding so fresh trainees can follow checklists immediately without my supervision, while eliminating my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation.
